name: 01-put-shipping-order
description: putShippingOrder echoes the order in a ShippingOrderConfirmation with orderReceivedStatus=true, and the async scope writes one CSV file with a header and one record per order item.

source.reference: legacy-modernization/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/LegacyModernizationIT.java (message.xml -> reply.xml, then Thread.sleep for the async file); legacy-modernization/src/test/resources/message.xml; legacy-modernization/src/test/resources/reply.xml; legacy-modernization/src/main/java/org/ordermgmt/FulfillmentImpl.java; legacy-modernization/src/main/app/FufillmentWebService.xml (async dw:transform-message %output application/csv header=true, file:outbound-endpoint outputPattern ShippingOrder-#[server.dateTime.format('dd-MM-yy_HH-mm-ss.SSS')].txt)

request.body:
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ord="http://ordermgmt.org/">
<soapenv:Header/>
<soapenv:Body>
<ord:putShippingOrder>
<shippingId>1234</shippingId>
<billingAddress>
<name>Mulesoft</name>
<line1>77 Geary St</line1>
<line2>Level 4</line2>
<city>San Francisco</city>
<stateOrProvinceCode>CA</stateOrProvinceCode>
<countryCode>USA</countryCode>
<postalCode>94108</postalCode>
</billingAddress>
<shippingAddress>
<name>Mulesoft</name>
<line1>77 Geary St</line1>
<line2>Level 4</line2>
<city>San Francisco</city>
<stateOrProvinceCode>CA</stateOrProvinceCode>
<countryCode>USA</countryCode>
<postalCode>94108</postalCode>
</shippingAddress>
<order>
<orderItem>
<merchantSKU>1234</merchantSKU>
<quantity>500</quantity>
</orderItem>
<orderItem>
<merchantSKU>6789</merchantSKU>
<quantity>1500</quantity>
</orderItem>
<orderItem>
<merchantSKU>9998</merchantSKU>
<quantity>5000</quantity>
</orderItem>
</order>
</ord:putShippingOrder>
</soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
